info.name: Nearby Teachers — Country, State and City
info.description: Public country, state and city APIs. Popular entries appear first in this order: India, United States, United Kingdom, Canada, United Arab Emirates, Bangladesh, Pakistan, Brazil, Australia, with is_popular:true. The complete alphabetical country list follows and includes these countries again without is_popular. Optional search applies to both sections. IDs refer to the same database country in both occurrences. Saved examples are abbreviated and fictional.

request.description: Required country_id from GET /geo/countries. Returns all states for that country (id, name, country_id). Optional search filters names.

originalRequest.description: Required country_id from GET /geo/countries. Returns all states for that country (id, name, country_id). Optional search filters names.

request.description: Required state_id from GET /geo/states. Returns all cities in that state (id, name, state_id). Optional search filters by city name; response has no pagination.

originalRequest.description: Required state_id from GET /geo/states. Returns cities in that state (id, name, state_id). Optional search, page and perPage; default 50, maximum 100 per page.
